commands.name: annotation add
commands.summary: Add a text, callout, shape, arrow, line, highlight or spotlight at a time.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: Left edge of the box, canvas pixels.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: Top edge of the box, canvas pixels.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text of a text item or callout (up to 1000 characters).

inputs.name: sketch
inputs.description: Seconds an arrow, line, rectangle or ellipse takes to draw itself on (0 = off).

inputs.name: style
inputs.description: Style fields to change: fill, fillAlpha, stroke, strokeWidth, color, font, size, bold, italic, align, radius, shadow, dim, feather.

commands.result: Object with the new annotation id.

commands.name: annotation duplicate
commands.summary: Copy an annotation just above the original, nudged down and right.
commands.result: Object with the new annotation id.

commands.name: annotation move
commands.summary: Move an annotation’s box by a distance in canvas pixels; x and y keyframes move with it.
commands.result: Object with the new left and top.

commands.name: annotation preset
commands.summary: Apply a ready-made style (title, lower third, code, note, warning ...) to an annotation.
commands.result: Object with the annotation id and the preset used.

commands.name: annotation remove
commands.summary: Remove an annotation.
commands.result: Object with the annotation id.

commands.name: annotation reorder
commands.summary: Change the drawing order: later annotations draw on top.
commands.result: Object with the annotation’s position in the order (0 = bottom).

commands.name: annotation update
commands.summary: Change an annotation’s text, timing, box, opacity or style. Keyframes and behavior are kept.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: Left edge of the box, canvas pixels.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: Top edge of the box, canvas pixels.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text of a text item or callout (up to 1000 characters).

inputs.name: sketch
inputs.description: Seconds an arrow, line, rectangle or ellipse takes to draw itself on (0 = off).

inputs.name: style
inputs.description: Style fields to change: fill, fillAlpha, stroke, strokeWidth, color, font, size, bold, italic, align, radius, shadow, dim, feather.

commands.result: Object with the annotation as it is now.

commands.name: audio denoise
commands.summary: Remove steady background noise from a clip. Decodes the sound, makes a new audio file in the bin and switches the clip to it.

inputs.name: sampleStart
inputs.description: Start (seconds into the clip) of a stretch that holds only noise.

inputs.name: sampleEnd
inputs.description: End (seconds into the clip) of that stretch.

commands.result: Object with the summary line and the id of the processed audio clip.

commands.name: audio duck
commands.summary: Make a narration clip pull the audio on the other tracks down while it speaks (or turn that off).

inputs.name: on
inputs.description: Ducking on (default true); false removes it.

inputs.name: thresholdDb
inputs.description: Speaking counts above this level, dBFS (default -40).

inputs.name: reductionDb
inputs.description: How far the others are pulled down, dB (default 12).

inputs.name: hold
inputs.description: Seconds to stay down across short pauses (default 0.2).

commands.result: Object with the clip’s ducking settings after the change (null when off).

commands.name: audio fade
commands.summary: Set the fade in and fade out of a clip’s sound, in seconds (0 removes a fade).

inputs.name: fadeIn
inputs.description: Seconds of fade in at the start.

inputs.name: fadeOut
inputs.description: Seconds of fade out at the end.

commands.result: Object with the clip’s audio settings after the change.

commands.name: audio level
commands.summary: Even out loud and quiet parts and bring a clip to a target loudness. Decodes the sound, makes a new audio file in the bin and switches the clip to it.
commands.result: Object with the summary line and the id of the processed audio clip.

commands.name: audio point-remove
commands.summary: Remove the volume point at a time.

inputs.name: time
inputs.description: Timeline position of the point, in seconds.

commands.result: Object with the volume points left.

commands.name: audio point-set
commands.summary: Set a volume point on a clip at a time (replaces a point at the same time). Between points the volume ramps.

inputs.name: time
inputs.description: Timeline position in seconds (clamped into the clip).

commands.result: Object with the volume points after the change.

commands.name: audio points-clear
commands.summary: Remove every volume point of a clip.
commands.result: Object with changed: true when points were removed.

commands.name: batch add
commands.summary: Queue an export (a preset, or the current export settings) for the batch.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: Name of a built-in or saved export preset; the other inputs are applied on top of it.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Export format when no preset is given.

commands.result: Object with the queue item id and label.

commands.name: batch cancel
commands.summary: Cancel a queued or running batch item.
commands.result: Object with the item id.

commands.name: batch clear
commands.summary: Remove the finished items from the batch queue.
commands.result: Object with how many items were removed.

commands.name: batch remove
commands.summary: Remove one item from the batch queue.
commands.result: Object with the item id.

commands.name: batch retry
commands.summary: Queue a failed or cancelled batch item again.
commands.result: Object with the item id.

commands.name: batch run
commands.summary: Run every queued export in order.

inputs.name: folder
inputs.description: Folder to write the files to (a path the host can reach).

commands.result: Object with counts of done, failed and cancelled items and the file names.

commands.name: behavior clear
commands.summary: Remove a clip’s entrance, emphasis or exit animation.
commands.result: Object with the clip’s behavior after the change.

commands.name: behavior set
commands.summary: Give a clip an entrance, emphasis or exit animation.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Preset: fade, slide-*, pop, spin for enter and exit; pulse or wobble for emphasis.

commands.result: Object with the clip’s behavior after the change.

commands.name: caption add
commands.summary: Add a caption at a time (after a caption already showing there, and ending before the next one).

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Caption text (up to 500 characters; default "New caption").

commands.result: Object with the new caption id.

commands.name: caption clear
commands.summary: Remove every caption.
commands.result: Object with how many captions were removed.

commands.name: caption export-srt
commands.summary: Return the captions as SubRip (.srt) text.
commands.result: Object with fileName, count and text.

commands.name: caption export-vtt
commands.summary: Return the captions as WebVTT (.vtt) text.
commands.result: Object with fileName, count and text.

commands.name: caption merge
commands.summary: Join a caption with the one after it: text on separate lines, time from the first start to the last end.

inputs.name: caption
inputs.description: Caption id (it is merged with the next one).

commands.result: Object with the merged caption id.

commands.name: caption remove
commands.summary: Remove a caption.
commands.result: Object with the caption id.

commands.name: caption set
commands.summary: Replace all captions with the cues in SRT or WebVTT text.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The text of an .srt or .vtt file.

commands.result: Object with how many captions were read and how many they replaced.

commands.name: caption shift
commands.summary: Move captions earlier or later by some seconds (never before 0).
commands.result: Object with how many captions were shifted.

commands.name: caption split
commands.summary: Cut the caption showing at a time in two, splitting the text in proportion.

inputs.name: time
inputs.description: Timeline position in seconds, inside a caption.

commands.result: Object with the ids of the two new captions.

commands.name: caption update
commands.summary: Change a caption’s text or timing.

inputs.name: end
inputs.description: New end in seconds (kept at least 0.05 s after the start).

commands.result: Object with the caption as it is now.

commands.name: clip add
commands.summary: Put a media item on the timeline at a time, on a track with room (a new track is added when none has).
commands.result: Object with the new clip id and the track it landed on.

commands.name: clip close-gaps
commands.summary: Close every gap on a track, from the start.
commands.result: Object with changed: true when something moved.

commands.name: clip crop
commands.summary: Show only part of the source picture. Fractions of the source frame; or an aspect ratio, or clear.

inputs.name: aspect
inputs.description: Crop to this width/height ratio, centred on the current crop (for example 1.7778).

commands.result: Object with the crop after the change (null when there is none).

commands.name: clip delete
commands.summary: Delete clips together with the clips linked or grouped with them.

inputs.name: ripple
inputs.description: Later clips on the same tracks close the gap (default: false).

commands.result: Object with the ids removed.

commands.name: clip detach-audio
commands.summary: Split the sound off a video clip onto its own linked audio clip.
commands.result: Object with the new audio clip id.

commands.name: clip duplicate
commands.summary: Copy clips (with their groups and links) to just after the selection, or to a given time (copy and paste).

inputs.name: at
inputs.description: Paste so the earliest clip starts here (default: right after the last clip).

commands.result: Object with the new clip ids.

commands.name: clip extend
commands.summary: Hold a clip’s last picture for some seconds after it ends.

inputs.name: ripple
inputs.description: Later clips move to make room (default: false).

commands.result: Object with the id of the clip that holds the picture.

commands.name: clip freeze
commands.summary: Hold the picture at a time for some seconds (a freeze frame).

inputs.name: time
inputs.description: Timeline position inside the clip, in seconds.

inputs.name: ripple
inputs.description: Later clips move to make room; otherwise the hold overwrites (default: false).

commands.result: Object with the id of the still clip.

commands.name: clip group
commands.summary: Put two or more clips in a group that selects, moves, trims and deletes together.
commands.result: Object with the group id.

commands.name: clip move
commands.summary: Move a clip (with its group or linked audio) to a start time, optionally on another track. It settles in the nearest free gap.

inputs.name: track
inputs.description: Track to move to (default: the same track).

commands.result: Object with the clips moved and where the clip landed.

commands.name: clip props
commands.summary: Set a clip’s position, size, rotation, opacity or volume.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: Centre of the clip on the canvas, in pixels.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: Centre of the clip on the canvas, in pixels.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: 1 fits the clip inside the canvas.

commands.result: Object with the clip properties after the change.

commands.name: clip remove-gap
commands.summary: Close the gap at a time on a track: later clips move earlier by the gap’s length.

inputs.name: time
inputs.description: A time inside the gap, in seconds.

commands.result: Object with the track and the clips that moved.

commands.name: clip speed
commands.summary: Change playback speed. The clip keeps showing the same stretch of source, so its length on the timeline changes.

inputs.name: ripple
inputs.description: Later clips on the track move to make room or close up (default: false).

commands.result: Object with the clip duration and speed after the change.

commands.name: clip split
commands.summary: Cut clips in two at a time: the given clips under it, otherwise every clip under it. Linked and grouped clips split too.

inputs.name: clips
inputs.description: Clips to split (default: every clip under the time).

commands.result: Object with the ids of the new right-hand halves.

commands.name: clip trim
commands.summary: Move one edge of a clip. Linked and grouped clips with the same edge follow.

inputs.name: time
inputs.description: New edge position on the timeline, in seconds.

commands.result: Object with the clip start and duration after the trim.

commands.name: clip ungroup
commands.summary: Dissolve the groups the given clips belong to.
commands.result: Object with the clips that were in a group.

commands.name: clip unlink
commands.summary: Break the link between a video clip and the audio detached from it, so they move separately.
commands.result: Object with the clips that were linked.

commands.name: cursor attach
commands.summary: Attach recorded cursor, click and key data (the text of a .cursor.json file) to a media item.
commands.result: Object with the counts of positions, clicks and key events attached.

commands.name: cursor detach
commands.summary: Remove the cursor data from a media item.
commands.result: Object with the media id.

commands.name: cursor reset
commands.summary: Remove every cursor effect setting from the project.
commands.result: Object with changed: true when there were settings.

commands.name: cursor settings
commands.summary: Change how the recorded cursor is drawn: shape, size, smoothing, highlight, magnify, spotlight, click rings and sounds, keystroke callouts.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Cursor effect setting "color" (default "#ffffff"). A colour as #rrggbb.

inputs.name: highlightColor
inputs.description: Cursor effect setting "highlightColor" (default "#ffd400"). A colour as #rrggbb.

inputs.name: clickColor
inputs.description: Cursor effect setting "clickColor" (default "#3ea6ff"). A colour as #rrggbb.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Replacement cursor picture as a data URL (PNG, SVG, WebP or JPEG, up to about 256 KB).

inputs.name: clearImage
inputs.description: Go back to the built-in cursor shapes.

commands.result: Object with the cursor settings after the change.

commands.name: effects clear
commands.summary: Remove every effect from clips.
commands.result: Object with the clips that were cleared.

commands.name: effects preset
commands.summary: Apply a one-click look (green screen, rounded card, device frames, colour looks, blend modes) on top of the current effects.
commands.result: Object with the clips that changed and the preset used.

commands.name: effects set
commands.summary: Apply effects to clips. Each group you give (colour, chroma, shadow, border, radius, mask, blend, frame) replaces that group; the others stay.

inputs.name: effects
inputs.description: Object with any of: colour, chroma, shadow, border, radius, mask, blend, frame.

commands.result: Object with the clips that changed.

commands.name: export cancel
commands.summary: Cancel the export that is running, or the whole batch.
commands.result: Object with cancelled: true.

commands.name: export gif
commands.summary: Render the timeline to an animated GIF.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: Name of a built-in or saved export preset; the other inputs are applied on top of it.

inputs.name: range
inputs.description: whole: the entire timeline (default); marks: the in to out marks.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Short side of the picture in pixels (default: the project size).

inputs.name: fps
inputs.description: Frames per second (default: the project rate).

inputs.name: optimize
inputs.description: Store only the changed part of each frame (default true).

inputs.name: captions
inputs.description: Burn the captions into the picture (default true).

inputs.name: out
inputs.description: Where to write the file (a path the host can reach). Without it the result carries a download.

commands.result: Object with the file name or path, byte size, format and a one-line summary.

commands.name: export m4a
commands.summary: Mix the timeline’s sound to an AAC M4A file.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: Name of a built-in or saved export preset; the other inputs are applied on top of it.

inputs.name: range
inputs.description: whole: the entire timeline (default); marks: the in to out marks.

inputs.name: out
inputs.description: Where to write the file (a path the host can reach). Without it the result carries a download.

commands.result: Object with the file name or path, byte size and format.

commands.name: export mp4
commands.summary: Render the timeline to an H.264 MP4 with AAC (or Opus) sound.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: Name of a built-in or saved export preset; the other inputs are applied on top of it.

inputs.name: range
inputs.description: whole: the entire timeline (default); marks: the in to out marks.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Short side of the picture in pixels (default: the project size).

inputs.name: fps
inputs.description: Frames per second (default: the project rate).

inputs.name: includeAudio
inputs.description: Mix the sound into the file (default true).

inputs.name: captions
inputs.description: Burn the captions into the picture (default true).

inputs.name: fast
inputs.description: Decode source video in order with WebCodecs (default true; falls back to seeking by itself).

inputs.name: chapters
inputs.description: Also write sidecar chapter files when chapter markers exist (default false).

inputs.name: out
inputs.description: Where to write the file (a path the host can reach). Without it the result carries a download.

commands.result: Object with the file name or path, byte size, format and a one-line summary.

commands.name: export png
commands.summary: Save one frame of the timeline as a PNG.

inputs.name: time
inputs.description: Timeline position of the frame in seconds (default 0).

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: Name of a built-in or saved export preset; the other inputs are applied on top of it.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Short side of the picture in pixels (default: the project size).

inputs.name: out
inputs.description: Where to write the file (a path the host can reach). Without it the result carries a download.

commands.result: Object with the file name or path, byte size and format.

commands.name: export wav
commands.summary: Mix the timeline’s sound to an uncompressed WAV file.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: Name of a built-in or saved export preset; the other inputs are applied on top of it.

inputs.name: range
inputs.description: whole: the entire timeline (default); marks: the in to out marks.

inputs.name: out
inputs.description: Where to write the file (a path the host can reach). Without it the result carries a download.

commands.result: Object with the file name or path, byte size and format.

commands.name: history redo
commands.summary: Redo an undone edit in the open editor.
commands.result: Object with how many edits were redone.

commands.name: history undo
commands.summary: Undo the last edit in the open editor.
commands.result: Object with how many edits were undone.

commands.name: keyframe clear
commands.summary: Remove every keyframe on a clip, or on one property.
commands.result: Object with changed: true when keys were removed.

commands.name: keyframe ease
commands.summary: Change the easing used from a keyframe to the next one.

inputs.name: time
inputs.description: Timeline position of the key, in seconds.

commands.result: Object with the keys on that property.

commands.name: keyframe remove
commands.summary: Remove the keyframe on a clip property at a time.

inputs.name: time
inputs.description: Timeline position of the key, in seconds.

commands.result: Object with the keys left on that property.

commands.name: keyframe set
commands.summary: Set a keyframe on a clip property at a time (replaces a key at the same time). Without a value, the property’s current value is keyed.

inputs.name: time
inputs.description: Timeline position in seconds (clamped into the clip).

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value to key (default: the value at that time).

commands.result: Object with the keys on that property after the change.

commands.name: library add
commands.summary: Add a file (logo, music, sting, short clip) to the library, which belongs to no project.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: Path of the file the host can read.

commands.result: Object with the library asset id and name.

commands.name: library remove
commands.summary: Remove an asset from the library. Projects that already use it keep their own copy.
commands.result: Object with the asset id.

commands.name: library save
commands.summary: Save a media item from this project to the library.
commands.result: Object with the library asset id and name.

commands.name: library use
commands.summary: Add a library asset to this project’s media bin.
commands.result: Object with the new media id.

commands.name: marker add
commands.summary: Add a marker on the timeline; a chapter marker is written to the exported video.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Marker name (up to 80 characters; default "Marker N").

commands.result: Object with the new marker id.

commands.name: marker chapter
commands.summary: Make a marker a chapter, or an ordinary marker again.

inputs.name: chapter
inputs.description: true: a chapter; false: an ordinary marker.

commands.result: Object with the marker as it is now.

commands.name: marker export-chapters
commands.summary: Return the chapter markers as a YouTube-style list or a WebVTT chapters track.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: text: "0:00 Title" lines; vtt: a chapters track.

commands.result: Object with fileName, count and text.

commands.name: marker move
commands.summary: Move a marker to a time.
commands.result: Object with the marker as it is now.

commands.name: marker remove
commands.summary: Remove a marker.
commands.result: Object with the marker id.

commands.name: marker rename
commands.summary: Rename a marker.
commands.result: Object with the marker as it is now.

commands.name: media add
commands.summary: Add a media item to the project by its metadata. The bytes come from a media import; this registers a description of a file.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: File name shown in the media bin.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Length in seconds (0 for an image).

inputs.name: hasAudio
inputs.description: The media has a sound track (default: true for video, false for an image; audio always has).

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Media id to use (default: a new one).

commands.result: Object with the media id.

commands.name: media import
commands.summary: Import media files (video, audio, images) into the project’s media bin.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: Path of a media file the host can read.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Name to show in the bin (default: the file name).

inputs.name: cursorData
inputs.description: Path of a .cursor.json file to attach (default: the file next to it, if any).

commands.result: Object with the new media item (id, name, kind, duration, size).

commands.name: media import-captures
commands.summary: Import the images and videos from a SnapShackle Captures folder.
commands.result: Object with the media items added and how many older captures were left out.

commands.name: media remove
commands.summary: Remove a media item and every clip that uses it.
commands.result: Object with the media id and how many clips went with it.

commands.name: package open
commands.summary: Open a .capstanz package: verify it, store its media, then open the project. A project already here opens as a copy.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: Path of the package file the host can read.

commands.result: Object with the opened project summary.

commands.name: package save
commands.summary: Save the project and all its media as one .capstanz package file.

inputs.name: out
inputs.description: Where to write the package (a path the host can reach). Without it the browser asks.

commands.result: Object with the file name or path, byte size and how many media files it holds.

commands.name: preset remove
commands.summary: Delete a saved export preset.
commands.result: Object with the preset name.

commands.name: preset save
commands.summary: Save export settings as a named preset in this browser.

inputs.name: range
inputs.description: whole: the entire timeline (default); marks: the in to out marks.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Short side of the picture in pixels (default: the project size).

inputs.name: fps
inputs.description: Frames per second (default: the project rate).

commands.result: Object with the preset id and name.

commands.name: project from-template
commands.summary: Replace the project with an empty one laid out like a built-in template.
commands.result: The new project summary.

commands.name: project new
commands.summary: Replace the project with a new, empty one.
commands.result: The new project summary.

commands.name: project open
commands.summary: Replace the project with one read from a .capstan file (the edit only; media bytes are not in it).

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: The project: an object, or the text of a .capstan file.

commands.result: The opened project summary.

commands.name: project resize
commands.summary: Change the canvas size; clips, annotations, zooms and blur regions keep their relative place.
commands.result: The project summary.

commands.name: project save
commands.summary: Write the project as .capstan file text (the edit only). The caller stores the text.
commands.result: Object with fileName and text (the JSON of the project).

commands.name: project set
commands.summary: Change the project name, frame rate or background colour.
commands.result: The project summary.

commands.name: project show
commands.summary: Show the project: size, frame rate, length and how many of each item it holds.
commands.result: Object with id, name, width, height, fps, background, duration (seconds) and counts per kind of item.

commands.name: project theme
commands.summary: Apply a theme to the project (today: the canvas background).
commands.result: Object with the theme id and the background now in use.

commands.name: projects delete
commands.summary: Delete a stored project and its media from this browser.
commands.result: Object with the deleted project id.

commands.name: projects duplicate
commands.summary: Copy a stored project, with its own copy of the media.
commands.result: Object with the new project id.

commands.name: projects list
commands.summary: List the projects stored in this browser.
commands.result: Array of project summaries (id, name, size, clips, updated).

commands.name: projects open
commands.summary: Open a project stored in this browser.
commands.result: The opened project summary and the names of any media missing from this browser.

commands.name: projects rename
commands.summary: Rename a stored project.
commands.result: Object with the project id and its new name.

commands.name: range clear
commands.summary: Clear the in and out marks.
commands.result: Object with changed: true when there was a range.

commands.name: range mark-in
commands.summary: Mark the start of the part to export (the out mark moves to the end if it would fall before it).
commands.result: Object with the range now set.

commands.name: range mark-out
commands.summary: Mark the end of the part to export (the in mark moves to 0 if it would fall after it).
commands.result: Object with the range now set.

commands.name: range set
commands.summary: Set the in and out marks: the part of the timeline an "In to out" export covers.
commands.result: Object with the range now set.

commands.name: record cancel
commands.summary: Abandon the recording without keeping it.
commands.result: Object with cancelled: true.

commands.name: record discard
commands.summary: Throw away a recording left behind by a crash or a closed window.
commands.result: Object with the session id.

commands.name: record pause
commands.summary: Pause the running recording; the pause is left out of the footage.
commands.result: Object with the seconds recorded so far.

commands.name: record recover
commands.summary: Import a recording left behind by a crash or a closed window.
commands.result: Object with the media ids added.

commands.name: record resume
commands.summary: Carry on a paused recording.
commands.result: Object with the seconds recorded so far.

commands.name: record start
commands.summary: Start a screen recording (and optionally webcam and microphone). The browser asks the person which screen, window or tab to share.

inputs.name: surface
inputs.description: What to share: a browser tab, a window or the entire screen (default window).

inputs.name: region
inputs.description: Pick a region of the shared surface to record.

inputs.name: hideCursor
inputs.description: Leave the mouse cursor out of the recording.

inputs.name: systemAudio
inputs.description: Record the sound the computer plays (default true).

inputs.name: separateAudio
inputs.description: Keep microphone and system sound as separate tracks.

inputs.name: webcam
inputs.description: Record the camera as its own track.

inputs.name: cameraId
inputs.description: Camera device id (default: the browser’s default camera).

inputs.name: webcamPip
inputs.description: Place the camera as a picture-in-picture on the timeline (default true).

inputs.name: countdown
inputs.description: Seconds of countdown before recording starts (default 3).

inputs.name: maxMinutes
inputs.description: Stop by itself after this many minutes (0 = no limit).

inputs.name: toDisk
inputs.description: Write the recording to the browser’s private disk space as it goes, so a crash loses nothing (default true).

inputs.name: addToTimeline
inputs.description: Put the recording on the timeline when it stops (default true).

commands.result: Object with the recording session id and the surface that was shared.

commands.name: record stop
commands.summary: Stop the recording and add it to the media bin (and the timeline).
commands.result: Object with the media ids added and the recorded seconds.

commands.name: redaction add
commands.summary: Add a region that blurs or pixelates every layer beneath it for a stretch of the timeline.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Width, canvas pixels (default: a quarter of the canvas).

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Height, canvas pixels (default: an eighth of the canvas).

commands.result: Object with the new region id.

commands.name: redaction remove
commands.summary: Remove a blur or pixelate region.
commands.result: Object with the region id.

commands.name: redaction update
commands.summary: Change a blur or pixelate region.
commands.result: Object with the region as it is now.

commands.name: session end
commands.summary: End the Capstan session: the local server stops once the window closes.
commands.result: Object with ended: true.

commands.name: template remove
commands.summary: Delete a template saved in this browser.
commands.result: Object with the template id.

commands.name: template save
commands.summary: Save the project’s layout (size, tracks, annotations, zooms, markers, cursor settings) as a template in this browser.
commands.result: Object with the template id and name.

commands.name: template use
commands.summary: Start a new project from a template saved in this browser.
commands.result: Object with the new project summary.

commands.name: track add
commands.summary: Add a track on top of the others.
commands.result: Object with the new track id.

commands.name: track remove
commands.summary: Remove a track and every clip on it. The last track cannot be removed.
commands.result: Object with the track id and how many clips went with it.

commands.name: track update
commands.summary: Rename a track, mute, hide or lock it, or make it magnetic (clips close up, no gaps).

inputs.name: hidden
inputs.description: Hide the track from the picture.

inputs.name: magnetic
inputs.description: Keep the track free of gaps; turning it on closes its gaps now.

commands.result: Object with the track as it is now.

commands.name: transition clear
commands.summary: Remove a clip’s transition at its start, its end or both.
commands.result: Object with the clip’s transitions after the change.

commands.name: transition set
commands.summary: Give a clip a transition at its start, its end or both.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Seconds (default 0.5; never more than half the clip).

commands.result: Object with the clip’s transitions after the change.

commands.name: zoom accept
commands.summary: Add zoom regions, for example ones returned by zoom suggest.

inputs.name: regions
inputs.description: Array of zoom regions (start, duration, x, y, width, height, and optionally easeIn, easeOut, ease).

commands.result: Object with the ids added.

commands.name: zoom add
commands.summary: Add a zoom-n-pan region: the camera zooms in on part of the canvas for a stretch of the timeline.

inputs.name: focusX
inputs.description: Canvas pixel the zoom is centred on (default: the middle).

inputs.name: focusY
inputs.description: Canvas pixel the zoom is centred on (default: the middle).

commands.result: Object with the new zoom region id.

commands.name: zoom duplicate
commands.summary: Copy a zoom region to start right after the original.
commands.result: Object with the new zoom region id.

commands.name: zoom remove
commands.summary: Remove a zoom region.
commands.result: Object with the zoom region id.

commands.name: zoom suggest
commands.summary: Suggest zoom regions from recorded cursor activity (clicks, clusters, dwells). Nothing is added.
commands.result: Object with regions: the suggested zoom regions, each with its own id.

commands.name: zoom update
commands.summary: Change a zoom region’s timing, rectangle, magnification or easing.

inputs.name: level
inputs.description: Magnification, 1.1 to 20; resizes the rectangle about its centre.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: Left edge of the rectangle, canvas pixels.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: Top edge of the rectangle, canvas pixels.

commands.result: Object with the zoom region as it is now.
